description: This Java class 'InteropWrapperBuilder' provides a builder pattern implementation for creating 'CommandWrapper' objects related to interoperability actions, such as registering or deleting account identifiers, creating transaction requests, quotes, and performing transfers within the 'Fineract' framework. It encapsulates URL paths and action types for different interoperation operations.

classes.name: InteropWrapperBuilder
classes.description: A builder class for constructing CommandWrapper instances for various interoperability actions such as account registration, deletion, transaction requests, quotes, and transfers.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Creates and returns a new CommandWrapper object with the parameters set by the builder.

methods.name: withJson
methods.description: Sets the JSON payload for the command.

methods.name: registerAccountIdentifier
methods.description: Prepares a command to register an account identifier with specified type, value, and optional sub-type.

methods.name: deleteAccountIdentifier
methods.description: Prepares a command to delete an account identifier with specified type, value, and optional sub-type.

methods.name: createTransactionRequest
methods.description: Prepares a command to create a new transaction request.

methods.name: createQuotes
methods.description: Prepares a command to create a new quote.

methods.name: performTransfer
methods.description: Prepares a command to perform a transfer action with a specific transfer type.
